limitations: Substantial and lasting are ordinary readings of the phrase, not numerical criteria supplied by Zitron.

No time limit can fairly be added after the fact.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Investors in Anthropic's IPO and Meta's stock sale will be left holding the bag.

statement.excerpt: That $97.5 billion number rivals the $50 billion to $100 billion Anthropic wants to raise in its IPO, and in both cases investors will be left holding the bag for two companies with little tangible proof that they can live up to their egregious promises.

from_speaker: investors will be left holding the bag
Anthropic wants to raise in its IPO
our_interpretation: Read holding the bag as substantial lasting investment losses for purchasers in the identified Anthropic and Meta offerings.
Assess the two investor groups separately. Losses in only one do not establish the prediction about both.
Measure returns against actual purchase prices, including distributions and corporate actions. Losses to investors are distinct from losses reported by the companies.
No deadline or numerical loss threshold is supplied. Do not invent a holding period or treat temporary price declines as permanent losses.
The offerings identify the investments being predicted, rather than an explicit if-then condition.
criteria.support_condition: Final distributions or another irreversible event establish substantial losses relative to purchase cost for investors in both identified offerings.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An irreversible cash exit or final distribution establishes that the relevant investors recovered their purchase cost and earned positive total returns, contradicting the loss prediction for that investor group.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A dated event fixing final recovery for the relevant offering investors would permit resolution under the early-resolution rule. Ordinary return comparisons would require a holding period and loss threshold that the original claim does not supply.
